messages:
Eli (growth): Quick note before KPI review: attribution for last quarters webinar-sourced revenue is inconsistent across reports. Some dashboards use last-touch, others multi-touch. Need a canonical approach.

Maya (analytics): Agreed. Current setup: reporting_api uses last-touch by default, cohort evals use linear multi-touch. That explains the 12% variance.

Riley (demand-gen): From a program POV multi-touch feels fairer 1 it credits nurture and top-of-funnel content. But sales prefers last-touch since demo booked = closed-won signal.

Eli (growth): Proposal: KPI deck shows both, but our weekly ops number should standardize on one. Recommend we use multi-touch for channel performance and last-touch for deal attribution. Thoughts?

Maya (analytics): Technically doable. Ill add both series to the dashboard and surface delta. Also will add a short note in the KPI doc explaining methods and formula: 
```
multi_touch = sum(lead_value * touch_weight) / total_touches
last_touch = assign to last non-null utm
```

Riley (demand-gen): That sounds pragmatic. Also request a separate table for webinars so we can track assisted conversions.

ops-bot: Task created: AT-908 "Standardize attribution reporting (multi vs last)" assigned to Maya, due 2026-03-22.

Eli (growth): Perfect. Put 3 slides in Fridays deck: 1) comparison chart, 2) recommended policy, 3) impact on top 5 channels. Well vote during KPI review."
